title: Hausa, Yoruba, Igbo & Swahili — Latin with combining marks

metadata.author: pdfnative-cli samples
metadata.subject: Four African languages set with the bundled latin module (pdfnative 1.8.0 latin-marks shaper) — demonstration content
metadata.keywords: hausa, yoruba, igbo, swahili, combining marks, tone marks

blocks.text: No new font, no new key

ha, yo, ig and sw are aliases of latin on the CLI: --font latin --lang ha,yo,ig,sw registers the one Noto Sans module. The 1.8.0 latin-marks shaper anchors free-standing combining marks (tone marks, dots below) on their base with the font's mark-to-base and mark-to-mark tables, so NFD text renders composed.
Sannu da zuwa. Ƙasar Hausa tana da ɓangarori da yawa; ɗan Adam yana koyon ƴan kalmomi kowace rana — ɓ, ɗ, ƙ and ƴ are hooked letters of their own.
Ẹ káàbọ̀. Ọ̀tọ̀ ìjọ àti ìlú: ẹ̀kọ́ ọmọdé ní ọjọ́ kọ̀ọ̀kan. Àwọn àmì ohùn (grave, acute) jókòó lórí àwọn fáwẹ́lì pẹ̀lú àmì abẹ́ (ẹ, ọ, ṣ).
Nnọọ. Ị̀ na-ekwu Igbo? Ụ̀mụ̀ akwụkwọ na-amụ ihe ọ̀hụ́rụ́ kwa ụbọchị — ị, ọ, ụ carry a dot below and a tone mark above.
Karibu sana. Lugha ya Kiswahili inazungumzwa Afrika Mashariki na inaandikwa kwa herufi za Kilatini bila alama za ziada — plain Latin, listed here because the alias exists for symmetry.
